title: Bound small paid remainders on the original 451-factor supplier
body:
## Result

This PR certifies **conditional κ = 0.00387992804554 on the original 451-factor supplier** at `d9c3e9ad79686d863cb30cf00f1e32e6c7461300`. The new proof bounds the number of small paid remainders and accounts for the root source mass at each height. Its power-16 comparison clears the previous power-17 proof's relaxed ceiling by exactly 19/1800000000000000. The 36-call binary word, 48-call signed rational caller, seven restored ordinary stages and all five conditional premises are inherited. [Proof and source ledger](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/d9c3e9ad79686d863cb30cf00f1e32e6c7461300/research/bit-451-height-dependent-sources/small-remainders)

**No verified κ gain over the latest peer benchmark.** Ali Romman's #8027 at `fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4` independently reproduces at **0.00389011507650** with new binary and rational words. This PR's strongest value is lower by **0.00001018703096**, a signed change of **−0.261869655772894%**, exactly (−2037406192/7780230153)%. All three peer commands passed locally, including the complete signed application. Its hosted planner failed and its scientific job was skipped at the refresh. Main selects #7000 at 0.00363005817. [Latest peer claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8027) · [Original-word result and scope](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7f24c9c570dd60a7aa89229c59cf50a7e9efeba0/ROUNDS-344-346.md)

| Complete original-word stage | κ | Absolute increase over preceding stage |
|---|---:|---:|
| Charged mean 749/1000, power 20 | 0.00387992804541 | +0.00000000000003 |
| Grouping actual unmatched sources, power 19 | 0.00387992804544 | +0.00000000000003 |
| Bounding the root fraction by height, power 18 | 0.00387992804547 | +0.00000000000003 |
| Three root ranges, power 17 | 0.00387992804551 | +0.00000000000004 |
| Counting small remainders, power 16 | **0.00387992804554** | **+0.00000000000003** |

The power-16 increase relative to the power-17 result is **+0.000000000773210215450%**, exactly (300/387992804551)%. Relative to the original #7863 supplier at 0.00387992804346 the accumulated increase is **+0.00000000000208**, or **+0.0000000536092416328711%**, exactly (10400/193996402173)%. These predecessor comparisons are historical. The original supplier's raw upper bound, 0.003879928046155, lies below the #8027 claim. [#7863](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7863) · [#7973 independent replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7973) · [Power-18 handoff and controls](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f6eb39804cb9eaefd927f8ede928ae7b453674f5/ROUNDS-341-343.md)

## Reproduction and verification

From a clean checkout of this PR head, use CPython 3.12. The first package checks the original supplier and its historical registered comparisons. The second rebuilds the native word, four complete signed application controls at powers 19–16, the all-height proofs, all stage floors and directed separation. The relative replay roots and file hashes are part of the public handoff.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-451-carrier-cover
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-451-height-dependent-sources
```

The final arithmetic replay covered **128 finite rows and 85 coefficients**; its independent solver took 0.122 seconds. The initial test of the previously restrictive height 16 saved no rows because all cases passed. The separate signed consumer took 26.578 seconds, tested 0.00387992804561 against the ordinary cap 0.00387992804562487, and checked both linear orientations, 54 strict and four functional conditions. The verifier rejects an underpriced cap, an extra paid position and corrupted data. Native all-column action, owned erasure, all-size compiler transfer, precision and tape, and analytic recovery remain conditional. [Independent receipt and single-command replay](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7f24c9c570dd60a7aa89229c59cf50a7e9efeba0/round345-frozen/README.md)

Local registered scientific replay passed, as did the planner, historical prerequisite and all 760 onboarding tests (31 local skips). The hosted power-20 head passed its actual scientific replay. Final head `d9c3e9ad79686d863cb30cf00f1e32e6c7461300` passed hosted onboarding and all three registered replay jobs. The signed carrier replay emitted `PASS_COMPLETE_SIBLING_CAPACITY` at 0.00387992804544. The height-dependent replay emitted `PASS_COMPLETE_SMALL_REMAINDER_SOURCE` at 0.00387992804554. [Final hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44928868835) · [Carrier science](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44928868835/job/136922003201) · [Small-remainder science](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44928868835/job/136922003187). [Previous hosted scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44925868806/job/136913020509)

Clear1nsight supplied the #7863 physical word, its price and the #7973 replay. Jacob Alan Sussman supplied the Pascal compiler, DreamingOfClouds the ambient cap and cover, zxv the weighted-exit and tensor comparison, JoyboyBrian the earlier paid moments and clipping, and Ali Romman the signed paired caller and newer #8027 circuits. Dugongue, Rohan Arun, Cinna Davis and the authors of the retained recovery and cutoff proofs are credited in the construction. OpenAI Codex materially assisted this campaign's proof, implementation, checking and packaging.
